sections.shortTitle: Public investments financial safeguards amendment ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
Public investments
(financial safeguards) (amendment) ordinance 2005
An
Ordinance to further amend the Public Investments
(Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th August, 2005]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Public Investments (Financial Safeguards) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005.
(2) it shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Public investments financial safeguards amendment ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4, Ordinance XLVI of 1960

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
Public investments
(financial safeguards) (amendment) ordinance 2005
An
Ordinance to further amend the Public Investments
(Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th August, 2005]
2. Amendment of section 4,
Ordinance XLVI of 1960.--In the Public Investment (Financial
Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960 (XLVI of 1960), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 4,--‑
(a) for the words, comma and
figure "Companies Act, 1913" the words, comma and figure
"Companies Ordinance, 1984" shall be substituted; and
(b) in the margin, for the
figures and word "VII of 1913" the figures and word "XLVII of
1984" shall be substituted.

Insertion of new section 9A, Ordinance, XLVI of 1960

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2005
Public investments

An
Ordinance to further amend the Public Investments
(Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th August, 2005]
3. Insertion of new section 9A,
Ordinance, XLVI of 1960.--In
the said Ordinance, after section 9 the following new section shall be
inserted, namely:--‑
"9A. Ordinance not to apply
to PTCL. Notwithstanding anything contained in this Ordinance the Pakistan Telecommunication
Company Limited upon its privatization pursuant to the Privatization Commission
Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000) shall not be deemed to be a corporation,
institution or undertaking established with the aid of public revenues of the
Federation or the Federal Government for the purpose of this Ordinance.".
